_about: Known-answer retrieval set for the knowledge base template. Written from the shipped bug cards, two digests, the HOT files and the index BEFORE the first run; never edit a case to fit a result. Answerable cases name the note that holds the answer (and, where one note holds many answers, a part of the heading of the section); abstain cases use words that appear nowhere in the template and must return nothing. The _floors block (added after the first run) is that run's exact result; kb_eval.py and kb_health.py --eval fail below it. Run: kb_eval.py --set <this file> on a copy of kb-template.
